info.name: Scalable ERP — Full API
info.description: All backend endpoints for the Scalable ERP system. Set baseUrl and run the Login request first — the token is saved automatically.

item.name: Raw Material Batches
item.description: Exposes GRN items as raw material batches. Populated after GRNs are approved/completed.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "ABC Supplies Ltd",
  "contactPerson": "John Doe",
  "email": "supplier@example.com",
  "phone": "+923001234567",
  "address": "123 Industrial Area, Karachi",
  "isActive": true
}

item.name: UOMs
item.description: Note: Create endpoint is DISABLED on the backend. GET without category returns object keyed by category; GET with category=X returns flat array.

body.raw:
{
  "grnItemId": "",
  "inspectionType": "VISUAL",
  "qualityStatus": "PASSED",
  "approvedQuantity": 95,
  "notes": "Visually inspected — minor surface damage on 5 units"
}

item.name: Factory Batches
item.description: Production/product batches. Filter by productId to see batches for a specific product.

item.name: Sites
item.description: Storage location hierarchy — warehouses, zones, rooms, etc. Every GRN batch requires a siteId.

body.raw:
{
  "wasteType": "DAMAGE",
  "itemType": "RAW_MATERIAL",
  "rawMaterialId": "{{rawMaterialId}}",
  "quantity": 25,
  "reason": "Roll damaged during forklift handling",
  "remarks": "Found during weekly stock check",
  "siteId": "{{siteId}}"
}
